notes: Genetic inactivation and LC-MS/MS characterization of the desABCD biosynthetic gene cluster (mibig:BGC0000940) in Streptomyces coelicolor M145 establish biosynthesis of linear desferrioxamine G (desferrioxamine G1) alongside desferrioxamines B and E.

In vitro enzymatic reconstitution of purified DesD (SCO2785) from the Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2) desABCD cluster (mibig:BGC0000940) demonstrates ATP-dependent condensation of N-hydroxy-N-succinylcadaverine into linear desferrioxamine G1 and cyclic desferrioxamine E.
Biosynthesis of the N-acetylated linear trihydroxamate siderophore desferrioxamine D1 by Streptomyces coelicolor M145 is directed by the genetically characterized desABCD locus (mibig:BGC0000940).

Structural and biochemical characterization of the Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2) acyltransferase DesC (mibig:BGC0000940) demonstrates substrate-tolerant acylation of N-hydroxycadaverine with acetyl-CoA and succinyl-CoA during assembly of acetylated linear desferrioxamines including desferrioxamine D1.

Identification and biochemical characterization of the mbtA-J NRPS-PKS gene cluster (mibig:BGC0001021) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv establish biosynthesis of the metal-free apo-siderophore desferrimycobactin T.
Targeted disruption of mbtB in Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv (mibig:BGC0001021) completely abolishes biosynthesis of both cell-wall desferrimycobactin T and secreted carboxymycobactins.

Purification and tandem mass-spectrometric structure elucidation of the major secreted extracellular hydroxamate-salicylate siderophore desferriexochelin 772MS (772SM) from iron-deficient axenic cultures of Mycobacterium tuberculosis Erdman.

The mbtA-J NRPS-PKS biosynthetic gene cluster (mibig:BGC0001021) of Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv directs assembly of the shared phenyloxazoline-bishydroxamate core of both cell-wall mycobactin T and secreted carboxymycobactins/exochelins including desferriexochelin 772MS.
Biosynthesis of the 2''S diastereomer pyochelin II by Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1 via the genetically characterized pchDCBAEFGHI gene cluster (mibig:BGC0000412).

In-frame deletion and in vitro enzymatic reconstitution of the flp/pab operon (PA2302-PA2306) in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1 demonstrate biosynthesis of the metal-free thiohydroxamate chelator fluopsin (N-methyl-N-hydroxythioformamide).

Genetic deletion and biochemical reconstitution of the PA2302-PA2306 operon in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1 demonstrate biosynthesis of the bis(N-methyl-N-hydroxythioformamido)copper(II) chalkophore complex fluopsin C.
Isolation, structural elucidation, and synthesis of thioformin (fluopsin) and its cupric complex YC 73 (fluopsin C) from Pseudomonas sp.

Insertional mutagenesis and sequence characterization of the rhbABCDEF siderophore biosynthesis operon in Sinorhizobium meliloti establish biosynthesis of the asymmetric citrate-based dihydroxamate siderophore rhizobactin 1021.
Genetic inactivation of the acsABCDEF biosynthetic operon and structural elucidation (PMID:10928541) establish biosynthesis of achromobactin by Dickeya chrysanthemi 3937.
Targeted deletion and biochemical reconstitution of the acs biosynthetic gene cluster in Pseudomonas syringae pv. syringae B728a establish biosynthesis of achromobactin.
